answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain proportional voting weight. Like a sparrow navigating a dangerous ledge, an agent risks its resources to prove commitment. If an attacker attempts to spawn violet-colored fake identities, they must expend significant capital per node, rendering the cost of flooding the network economically irrational compared to the diminishing marginal utility of each forged identity.
